item.title: French Fiscal Concerns Bring Home Painful Risk Premium
item.description: [Bloomberg] After decades of budget deficits and steadily rising debt, markets are putting a new price on French risk. Ozan Tarman, Vice Chair: Global Macro at Deutsche Bank, discusses the growing debt pressures across Europe and contagion risks. (Source: Bloomberg)

[Bloomberg] On this episode of Stock Movers:
